```lean
by
  have h4 : a + b + c = 5 + 7 := by rw [h₁, add_assoc]
  have h5 : a + b + c = 6 + b := by rw [h₂, add_assoc]
  have h6 : 5 + 7 = 6 + b := by rw [h4, h5]
  have h7 : b = 5 + 7 - 6 := by rw [h6, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have h8 : b = 6 := by simp [h7]
  rw [h8] at h₁ h₂ h₃
  have h9 : a + 6 = 5 := by rw [h₁]
  have h10 : a + 6 = 6 := by rw [h₃]
  have h11 : 5 = 6 := by rw [h9, h10]
  exact h11
```
